Connect to a PostgreSQL database server.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Establishes a connection to PostgreSQL for executing queries and reading/writing data. Supports connection pooling and SSL.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Database](../categories/database.md) |
| Status | Can't run yet |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Connection** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Database connection handle |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| host | `host` | Text | `localhost` |   | The run | Database host. |
| port | `port` | Integer | `5432` | `1-65535` | The run | Port number. |
| database | `database` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Database name. |
| username | `username` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Username. |
| password | `password` | Password | (empty) |   | The run | Password (stored securely) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
